sources.title: 2026 Auto Insurance Cost Comparison Survey
sources.terms: Site footer: 'Copyright © 2025 North Dakota Insurance & Securities Department'. The Department's disclaimer (https://www.insurance.nd.gov/disclaimer) says: 'Unless otherwise noted on an individual document, file, web page or other website items, the Department grants permission to copy and distribute the information for non-commercial use, as long as the content remains unaltered.' It also says the Department 'does not warrant or represent that this information is current, complete and accurate.' We copy the figures unaltered (six-month figures are also kept as printed in each locator). Example #4 is left out because its company labels do not match the figures (see data/factors/sources/README.md).

sources.title: Insurance losses by make and model, 2022–24 models
sources.terms: Source: www.iihs.org. The IIHS copyright page (https://www.iihs.org/copyright-information-and-privacy-policy) says: 'The content on this website is made available for limited noncommercial, educational and personal use only; a user may download content to share with others for limited noncommercial and educational purposes without requesting specific permission.' and 'Repetitive noncommercial, educational, or personal use and copying or redistribution in any manner for commercial use is not permitted without written permission from the Institute.' Requests go to legal@iihs.org. Permission was requested from legal@iihs.org on 22 September 2026; we are waiting for a reply. If they decline, we switch the rows off. The per-model rows are one file (sources/hldi-2022-24.csv) with one switch (useHldiModels in vehicle-families.json).
